_readme: Capture template for the quantum run. The session is short and cannot be repeated cheaply, so collect every field below in the same session.
usageSeconds is BILLED QPU execution time; submittedAt/ranAt/completedAt are wall clock including queue. They differ by orders of magnitude.
measurements MUST be the ordered per-shot bitstrings, not aggregated counts.
counts and measurements are cross-checked: if both are present they must agree exactly.
qubitLayout is the physical qubits the transpiler used.
This file is the site-compatible shape (job, plan, spores). The program also writes run.json with the frozen plan and cost ledger.
